#!/bin/bash
#FLUX --job-name=UCR_Heartbeat        # name of job
#FLUX --ntasks=1                   # total number of processes (= number of GPUs here)
#FLUX --gpus-per-task=1                 # number of GPUs
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=10           # number of cores per task
# NOTE: The SLURM hint '--hint=nomultithread' has been omitted as there is no
# direct Flux equivalent. Flux's default binding may utilize SMT/hyper-threading
# if available, which could have performance implications if the workload is
# sensitive to it.
#FLUX --time=20:00:00              # maximum execution time requested (HH:MM:SS)
#FLUX --output=auto_script/output_log/UCR_Heartbeat.out    # name of output file
#FLUX --error=auto_script/output_log/UCR_Heartbeat.out     # name of error file (here, in common with the output file)


# cleans out the modules loaded in interactive and inherited by default 
module purge
 
# loading of modules
module load pytorch-gpu/py3/1.7.0
 
# echo of launched commands
set -x

# code execution
python -u script_exp_dataset.py ../../../data/UCR_UEA/Heartbeat.pickle 1000 3 8 0.8

However, the script does not contain a command to create this directory structure (e.g., `mkdir -p auto_script/output_log`). If these directories do not exist in the working directory at job launch time, the job will fail immediately because it cannot open its log files.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=UCR_Heartbeat        # name of job
#SBATCH --ntasks=1                   # total number of processes (= number of GPUs here)
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1                 # number of GPUs (1/4 of GPUs)
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10           # number of cores per task (1/4 of the 4-GPUs node)
#SBATCH --hint=nomultithread         # hyperthreading is deactivated
#SBATCH --time=20:00:00              # maximum execution time requested (HH:MM:SS)
#SBATCH --output=auto_script/output_log/UCR_Heartbeat.out    # name of output file
#SBATCH --error=auto_script/output_log/UCR_Heartbeat.out     # name of error file (here, in common with the output file)


# cleans out the modules loaded in interactive and inherited by default 
module purge
 
# loading of modules
module load pytorch-gpu/py3/1.7.0
 
# echo of launched commands
set -x

# code execution
python -u script_exp_dataset.py ../../../data/UCR_UEA/Heartbeat.pickle 1000 3 8 0.8
